verdict.rationale: Datadog's API reference lets you pick an official client library on each endpoint to see code examples. Datadog also provides its own Postman collection for running authenticated requests. So the reference is browsable and has executable examples, but there is no evidence of an in-browser 'try it' console. Missing for 10: in-browser runnable or try-it execution in the reference itself, a published OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Select one of our official [client libraries](/extend/community/libraries/) languages in each endpoint to see code examples from that library.
To authenticate to the Datadog API through Postman, add your Datadog API and Application key values to the **Collection variables** of the Datadog API collection.
